**Read this first.** This release builds a route through Montserrat that is not a fight against
every pack in the abbey. Most of it was played as it was built -- the gate, the cell, the five
ways out, the escort, the hall. Sahar's talk for a prisoner, the ring she gives you, and what
happens to the garrison when she dies are built and not yet played. If you would rather wait for
a build somebody has walked end to end, wait for 0.11.1.

## The Prisoner of Montserrat

**Give yourself up.** Walk to the abbey gate and the sentry stops you: the captain said one might
come up the road on their own feet. Say you are the Scion and your steel is taken -- every named
weapon comes back to you later exactly as it was, the rest as plain blades, plus two good ones
the invaders had no use for, all on a pile by the gate. Outwit him and you keep your arms; walk
up as a Demokin or a Sylvant and you are not searched at all. Or draw, and it goes as it always
did. A sack goes over your head.

**The undercroft.** You wake in a cell under the abbey -- a new map, the cellars the abbey
always had and never showed you. A handler sits outside with your keys on his belt and a knife
in his hand. Five ways out: pick the lock; break the pins if you are strong enough, and fight him
and the two who come down the stair; talk him into walking you up; wait for the escort; or
listen to the old monk in the next cell, the only monk left in the house, who knows about a drain
under your straw. That last one is the only way out he never sees.

**The hall.** Get out quietly and the abbey treats you as what it thinks you are -- a delivery.
The packs stand and let you pass. Get out loud, and they hunt you. Get walked up under guard and
you are taken straight to her.

**Sahar.** She has orders, no wagons and no sisters to spare, and a prisoner who volunteers to go
north is the cheapest way to obey them. Fight her; outwit her; or take her ring and her word and
walk out through a garrison that will not touch you. The ring is worth exactly one abbey. Brother
Michel knows what it is. Machiavelli, if you meet him, knows better than anyone. The Crypt's
assassins know whose mark it is, and what it will cost her.

**The rout.** Kill her and every pack still standing turns for the door.

## Also in this release

- **The trolls' ore chest.** The chief pays you from it, and opening it unpaid, at peace, is
  theft -- the trolls say so, and then they show you.
- **The Wasp Queen.** The Grove's second cave was always a nest. Now it has a queen: the cursed
  wasp at twice its size, 200 hit points, two stingers for Quinn. The project's first authored
  creature model.
- The stash chests, the jailor's lesson, Esteban's death and the returns-after-attack from
  0.10.1 through 0.10.3 are all here.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over any earlier release. **Montserrat needs a
character who has never entered it.** The trolls' chest needs one who has not entered the Troll
Pit; Machiavelli's inn reaction one who has not entered the inn. Sahar's talk, Michel's and the
Crypt assassin's lines are dialogue and work on any save.
